en.title: Early-season mandarin box
en.summary: Refreshing sweetness and gentle tartness in a handy box.
en.cover_alt: A small box of early-season mandarins
en.html:
A small box of easy-to-eat mandarins for autumn and winter.

They make a lovely snack during a busy day.
